solver_sql: WITH step1 AS (SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason AS bp JOIN player AS p ON bp.player_id COLLATE BINARY = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.player_id, s.bats, s.avg_doubles, s.avg_doubles * 1.0 / o.overall_avg AS ratio FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT bats, AVG(ratio) AS hand_avg FROM step3) SELECT s.player_id, s.bats, s.avg_doubles, s.ratio, s.ratio - h.hand_avg AS difference FROM step3 AS s JOIN step4 AS h ON s.bats COLLATE BINARY = h.bats COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH category_counts AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS description, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM Products AS p JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON p.production_type_code COLLATE BINARY = pc.production_type_code COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), shares AS (SELECT description, product_count, product_count * 1.0 / total.product_count AS share FROM category_counts CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(product_count) AS product_count FROM category_counts) AS total WHERE total.product_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM shares) SELECT s.description, s.product_count, s.share, s.share - a.share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.share

WITH district_counts AS (SELECT c.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3), region_totals AS (SELECT region, SUM(client_count) AS region_count FROM district_counts), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_count FROM district_counts) SELECT dc.district_id, dc.region, dc.client_count, CAST(dc.client_count AS REAL) / rt.region_count AS region_share, CAST(dc.client_count AS REAL) / gt.total_count AS overall_share FROM district_counts AS dc JOIN region_totals AS rt ON dc.region = rt.region CROSS JOIN grand_total AS gt WHERE gt.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY overall_share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH step1 AS (SELECT x.link_to_budget AS budget_id, e.location AS location, AVG(x.cost) AS avg_cost FROM expense AS x JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY x.link_to_budget, e.location), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cost) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.budget_id, s.location, s.avg_cost, s.avg_cost - t.overall_avg AS deviation FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS t WHERE t.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT location, AVG(deviation) AS location_avg FROM step3) SELECT s.budget_id, s.location, s.avg_cost, s.deviation, s.deviation - l.location_avg AS difference FROM step3 AS s JOIN step4 AS l ON s.location = l.location WHERE s.deviation > l.location_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
